clauses.quote: Contract teachers with less than full-time FTE will be expected to perform their prorated share of consultation/preparation time
clauses.subject_text: Contract teachers with less than full-time FTE

clauses.quote: and to assume their pro-rated share of necessary professional duties.
clauses.subject_text: Contract teachers with less than full-time FTE

clauses.quote: Contractual leave benefits will be extended to cover the extra period for teachers who have agreed to teach an extra period during the regular school day.
In the event the Board of Education approves a school-day schedule different from the day described in 7.7.1 or 7.7.2, the District and Association will jointly develop an FTE calculation grid.
clauses.notes: Joint duty between management and union.

clauses.quote: Each school will be provided with well-ventilated, clean, adequate, separate rest rooms for men and women teachers.
There shall be a furnished room in each school to be used as a faculty lounge.
clauses.notes: Existential 'there' clause functioning as a district obligation.

clauses.quote: Each school shall have telephone service available to teachers that provides privacy of conversation.
Space in the parking lot at each school will be reserved for the parking of teachers' cars.
clauses.subject_text: Space in the parking lot at each school
